recommended_phases.title: Phase 1: BaseEntity foundation
recommended_phases.rationale: Zero-dependency base model shared by all domain entities. Must exist first.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 2: LeaveType and LeaveStatus enums
recommended_phases.rationale: Standalone value objects with no internal dependencies. Required by all downstream domain models.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 3: LeaveRequest model and repository interface
recommended_phases.rationale: Core domain entity depending on BaseEntity, LeaveType, and LeaveStatus. Repository interface defines persistence contract.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 4: LeaveBalance model and repository interface
recommended_phases.rationale: Balance entity depending on BaseEntity and LeaveType. Repository interface for balance persistence.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 5: LeavePolicy model and repository interface
recommended_phases.rationale: Policy entity depending on BaseEntity and LeaveType. Defines accrual rules and entitlement caps per leave type.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 6: AuditLog model, repository interface, and audit service interface
recommended_phases.rationale: Cross-cutting audit concern. Depends only on BaseEntity. Required by all service layers for GP-002 compliance.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 7: Balance service
recommended_phases.rationale: Domain service orchestrating balance queries, deductions, and accruals. Depends on LeaveBalance, LeavePolicy, and AuditLog.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 8: Notification service
recommended_phases.rationale: Domain service for leave-related notifications. Depends on AuditLog. Independent of other services.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 9: Approval service
recommended_phases.rationale: Manager approval/rejection logic. Depends on LeaveRequest, Balance, Notification, and AuditLog. Orchestrates balance deduction on approval.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 10: Leave service, controller, and routes
recommended_phases.rationale: Top-level application service and HTTP layer. Depends on LeaveRequest, Balance, Approval, and Notification. Exposes REST endpoints with RBAC enforcement.

app_notes: Layer boundaries: BaseEntity, LeaveType, LeaveStatus are pure domain value-objects (innermost). LeaveRequest, LeaveBalance, LeavePolicy are domain entities with repository interfaces. AuditLog is a cross-cutting domain concern. Balance, Notification, Approval are domain services. Leave is the application service + HTTP layer (outermost). Dependencies flow strictly inward: Leave → Approval/Balance/Notification → domain entities → value objects. No circular dependencies exist — verified via the dependencyMap: every edge points from a higher-layer module toward a lower-layer module. All state-changing operations route through AuditLog (GP-002). Repository interfaces enforce GP-001. RBAC enforcement lives in leave.routes.ts (GP-005). Input validation at controller boundaries (GP-003).
